core.title: Fluted Back-To-Back Door Handle, Pair, Emtek BTB-86347
tags: Emtek Fluted Lost Wax Cast Bronze Pull Sets

text.description_html:
Emtek BTB-86347, Back-to-Back Fluted Door Pull Set

The Fluted Back-To-Back Door Handle is available in 12 inch or 18 inch lengths. The Back-to-Back Fluted Door Pull Set comes packaged as a set of 2 handles and the necessary mounting hardware. It will fit doors 1-3/8 inches to 2-1/4 inches thick. Choose from either flat black or medium bronze finishes. Emtek's Fluted Lost Wax Cast Bronze Pull Set is great for farmhouses and Colonial homes.

Back-to-Back Mounting: Pulls bolt to each other through the door. Packaged with 2 door pulls (1 door pull for each side of a door).

Also Available: Fluted Pull with Thru-Bolt Mounting

Specifications of the Emtek Fluted Lost Wax Cast Bronze Pull Set:

  • Material: Lost Wax Cast Bronze
  • Door Thickness: for doors 1-3/8" to 2-1/4" thick.
  • Includes installation hardware required for fiberglass, wood, and metal doors.
  • Emtek Fluted Pull Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Available in 2 Sizes:

    EMT-BTB-86347:
    • Total Length: 12-7/8"
    • Center to Center Length: 12"
    • Pull Handle Width: 1"
    • Total Projection: 2"
    • Base: 1"

    EMT-BTB-86348:
    • Total Length: 18-7/8"
    • Center to Center Length: 18"
    • Pull Handle Width: 1"
    • Total Projection: 2"
    • Base: 1"

Sold as a Pair (2 Door Pulls) with Back-to-Back mounting.
